My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
Many, many thanks[.] the birthday[^2] for which the Heroes were wanted comes tomorrow, so nothing can be more convenient.

The [Lances](../books.html#23) look very well

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: CMY’s nephew, [Francis Arthur Yonge](../persons.html#1607) was going to be seven on 23 November 1868.
